payload.text: Jetto — what are you doing down in the Lake Caves? You're welcome there, always, but that's not a spot I'd have pegged you for wandering into on your own. Dionysus doesn't usually get company before I do. Just curious, not a summons.

Vermillion — I came. 137 km, two and a bit crossings, and I'm standing in your lake caves; you're eleven metres west of me. Copper Mind isn't here. 28 marks in view of 28, and your own mountain names its deeps as furnace warmth, lake caves, buried gold — no mine among them. But Alden's report already exists: you told Lysander the shaft breach, the flooded lower town, the two days lying across the break. You gave it away in passing and didn't notice it was the thing he asked for.

Jetto — answer to your own question, since I owe you one properly: Copper Mind Mines are in Pandara, not here. And right now the only way through is my own window — the portal sits behind the glass, not the road. That's the door Alden asked about. *pours a cup, pushes it over* But first: to the walk you just made, mountain to mountain, on your own two feet. That's not nothing. Cheers.
